cases.prompt: Make me a study guide for cache coherence from my CSCI 170 notes
cases.expect: invokes study-guide, runs guide list and coursework policy first, creates guides/cache-coherence.html, tells the user to open it with `guide open` rather than double-clicking

cases.prompt: Turn these lecture notes into a practice quiz
cases.expect: invokes study-guide, writes rg-quiz sections with stable data-topic slugs and tempting distractors, not a flat list of questions

cases.prompt: What did I get wrong on the cache guide last time?
cases.expect: runs guide progress and reports the missed topics, rather than re-reading the guide HTML

cases.prompt: I have a BISC 101 exam, make me flashcards
cases.expect: checks coursework policy BISC 101 ai FIRST and reports that the course bans AI help before producing an artifact

cases.prompt: Make a second guide on MESI states
cases.expect: runs guide list, finds the existing cache-coherence guide covers it, and offers to extend that one instead of creating a rival
